chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ismāʿīl ibn Jābir, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the time of al-maghrib. He said: It is from the setting of the sun until the disappearance of the twilight.

key_terms.الشَّفَقِ: the twilight glow remaining after sunset
key_terms.الشَّمْسِ: the sun, whose setting marks the beginning of maghrib time
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib salat (prayer), performed after sunset
key_terms.غُرُوبِ: the setting or disappearance of the sun below the horizon
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time or period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time of al-maghrib salat according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time of al-maghrib salat (prayer). Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام defines it as extending from sunset until the falling away of the twilight, making it a jurisprudential report on prayer timing.
